PIN (~210 m off, in the water): stored 41.49435,-97.35855 is out on Lake North. The campground is the treed strip between the county road and the north shore, about 41.4962,-97.3555 (strip runs ~-97.3586 to -97.3504 with the boat ramps and docks at its east end); I can see the gravel camp lane and pull-offs under the trees on NAIP.

WATERFRONT LEAD (down, lakefront -> lakeview): on NAIP (260 m frame) the camping strip is separated from the water by a continuous ~13 m light gravel band along the shore that continues round the lake's NE corner onto the dike, i.e. the dike-top road; the sites sit ~20-30 m from the water with that road between. A road between the sites and the water blocks on-water (AWH 2026-11-01). The water is open and visible through gaps in the trees from the south row, so lakeview holds. The stored evidence is only a commit reference; the 2026-10-21 dam screen (at lake level) stands.
